scenes.title: One continuous dusk location: a single white paper boat on a rain puddle in wet dark pavement, with soft amber city-light reflections.
scenes.purpose: One continuous dusk location: a single white paper boat on a rain puddle in wet dark pavement, with soft amber city-light reflections. Close-up followed by wide view; 12 seconds total.

dbc685ff-bcb4-420e-a637-6bca21298557.framing: Low water-level close-up; boat fills most of the frame.
dbc685ff-bcb4-420e-a637-6bca21298557.purpose: Introduce the solitary paper boat in close-up.
dbc685ff-bcb4-420e-a637-6bca21298557.imagePrompt: Cinematic naturalistic low water-level close-up of one small white folded paper boat floating on a shallow rain puddle in dark wet city pavement at dusk. Crisp triangular central fold, pointed bow facing screen right, intact white paper. Cool blue-gray twilight with soft amber city-light reflections on water, delicate circular rain ripples, shallow depth of field. No other boats, people, lettering or logos.
dbc685ff-bcb4-420e-a637-6bca21298557.motion: Locked camera; subtle rocking and concentric rain ripples.

28758bf4-f2fb-46ed-8a33-cbfbb97fe119.framing: Wide low-angle view showing the entire puddle and surrounding wet pavement.
28758bf4-f2fb-46ed-8a33-cbfbb97fe119.purpose: Reveal the boat's wider rain-soaked city setting.
28758bf4-f2fb-46ed-8a33-cbfbb97fe119.imagePrompt: Cinematic naturalistic wide low-angle view of a shallow rain puddle in dark wet city pavement at dusk. The same single small white folded paper boat sits near the center of the puddle, with a crisp triangular central fold and pointed bow facing screen right. Show the whole puddle and surrounding wet pavement; distant city lights are softly out of focus. Cool blue-gray twilight and soft amber reflections match the close-up. Delicate circular rain ripples. No other boats, people, lettering or logos.
28758bf4-f2fb-46ed-8a33-cbfbb97fe119.motion: Locked wide camera; subtle boat rocking and rain ripples.
